thread:
alex_w: Handoff (late-afternoon). Quick summary: small embed ingest spike in eu-west1 causing backlog growth and some 429s from the rate-limiter. Mitigations applied (drain + kvcache ttl bump).

alex_w: What I did: rotated pods for embed-consumer-2/3, bumped replicaCount to 6, applied emergency kvcache TTL patch (30m -> 2h), disabled retriever v2 canary in eu-west1.

alex_w: Current incident: INC-1842 — embed-queue-pileup (eu-west1). Symptoms: ingestion latency up, backlog ~1.2k, some 5xx -> converted to 429 by autothrottle. No customer-facing SLO breach yet.

priya_m: Thanks. Did you file an infra ticket to add capacity if needed?

alex_w: Yep opened INF-3219 and assigned to mateo_g — link in ticket (internal).

mateo_g: I'm checking quotas and nodegroups now. If we need more capacity I'll spin up a dedicated worker ASG. ETA ~25m.

jenna_r: Any user-visible errors or support pings? Should growth/product be notified?

alex_w: Not yet — only internal alerts for ingestion latency. I left a short note in #ops-incident. I'll post to #customer-impact only if we see SLOs tripped.

deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-17T15:02Z: patch applied: kvcache-ttl updated on embed-consumer (rev v1.2.7) :white_check_mark:

priya_m: I also disabled the canary for retriever v2 in eu-west1 so traffic falls back to retriever v1 until we confirm backlog drop. Safe to re-enable after backlog <200.

mateo_g: K8s quota looks fine. Starting worker pool scale-up: `kubectl scale deploy/embed-worker --replicas=10 -n inference`. Monitoring now.

alex_w: Watch for OOM evictions in consumer logs — I saw a couple before rotating pods: `kubectl logs -n inference embed-consumer-2 | grep -i eviction`. If evictions persist, lower batch size.

jenna_r: I'll monitor support queue and escalate if any customer messages come in.

mateo_g: Backlog breathing down to ~600 after scale-up and TTL bump. Still watching headroom.

alex_w: I'm heading offline in ~40m; mateo will be primary oncall. Left runbook updates in #oncall-runbooks and flagged INF-3219 with what I changed.

priya_m: Noted. If the backlog spikes again, route retriever traffic to eu-central (temp).

alex_w: ping @channel if anything regresses. Handoff complete. :wave:
